faqs.question: How long does a typical Headless CMS Development engagement take?
faqs.answer: Schema + front-end foundations usually take 5–10 weeks. Multi-brand or localization programs take longer and are phased.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing teams and tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We train editors, integrate your design system, and connect preview/publishing into your existing workflows.

faqs.question: How do you measure success?
faqs.answer: Time-to-publish, content reuse, page performance, preview reliability, and reduction in developer tickets for content changes.

faqs.question: Which CMS do you recommend?
faqs.answer: Often Sanity for structured content flexibility; WordPress headless when editorial familiarity matters. We decide after content modeling workshops.

faqs.question: Will marketing still preview pages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Draft/preview workflows are a first-class requirement, not a nice-to-have.

faqs.question: Can one CMS power web and app?
faqs.answer: That is the point of headless — shared content models with channel-specific presentations.

faqs.question: Migration from a page-builder site?
faqs.answer: We map pages to structured sections, migrate content carefully, and keep redirects so SEO equity survives.

faqs.question: Governance for large teams?
faqs.answer: Roles, workflows, validation, and component guardrails so brand stays consistent as more editors join.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: A content model workshop clarifies types and relationships before any UI is built — saving expensive rework.

faqs.question: Who delivers the CMS build?
faqs.answer: CMS architect + front-end engineers, with editor training and documentation at handover.
